**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, anti-poaching, or no-hire covenant binding Meridian Fieldworks. Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "no-hire", "induce", "recruit", and "personnel" surfaced only Vendor-side personnel obligations (§§ 3.1, 14.2, 16.2, 30.1) and § 12.3, which affirmatively records that Customer has made **no no-hire commitment** and remains free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment.

This meets our preferred position outright, so no redline was proposed. For completeness: § 12.4's 24-month competitive restriction on Customer is a serious issue, but it is a non-compete/exclusivity term rather than an employee non-solicit, and is properly flagged under that rule rather than double-flagged here.
